"""Full byte/mode custody for original696 four-suite and pure32 supplemental evidence."""
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
import os
import stat
import tarfile
from admission_common import SHA, need, read, data, write, safe_path, same, digest_file

MEMBER_SCHEMA = "heptatorch.sum03.original76.complete-supplement-members.v1"
BINDING_SCHEMA = "heptatorch.sum03.original76.supplement-binding.v1"

def inventory(directory):
    root = Path(directory).resolve()
    need(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), "real-original-evidence-directory")
    files, directories = {}, {"": stat.S_IMODE(root.stat().st_mode)}
    for base, dirs, names in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        dirs.sort()
        names.sort()
        parent = Path(base)
        for name in dirs:
            p = parent/name
            need(p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink(), "no-symlink-or-special-evidence-directory", path=str(p))
            directories[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)
        for name in names:
            p = parent/name
            need(not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_ISREG(p.stat().st_mode),
                 "only-regular-original-evidence-files", path=str(p))
            rel = p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            files[rel] = {**digest_file(p), "source_path": str(p)}
    return files, directories

def full_xz(path):
    digest_file(path)
    decoder = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ)
    raw_hash, raw_bytes = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        while not decoder.eof:
            block = stream.read(65536) if decoder.needs_input else b""
            need(block or not decoder.needs_input, "one-XZ-stream-not-truncated")
            raw = decoder.decompress(block, max_length=1 << 20)
            raw_hash.update(raw)
            raw_bytes += len(raw)
        need(not decoder.unused_data and stream.read(1) == b"", "one-XZ-stream-complete-physical-EOF")
    return {"uncompressed_tar_bytes": raw_bytes, "uncompressed_tar_sha256": raw_hash.hexdigest(),
            "single_XZ_stream": True}

def create_archive(output, manifest):
    path = Path(output)
    need(not path.exists(), "create-only-complete-archive")
    with path.open("xb") as target:
        with lzma.LZMAFile(target, "w", format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, check=lzma.CHECK_CRC64) as packed:
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=packed, mode="w|", format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT) as tar:
                for name, mode in sorted(manifest["directories"].items()):
                    safe_path(path.parent, name)
                    info = tarfile.TarInfo(name+"/")
                    info.type, info.size, info.mode = tarfile.DIRTYPE, 0, mode
                    info.uid = info.gid = info.mtime = 0
                    info.uname = info.gname = ""
                    tar.addfile(info)
                for name, entry in sorted(manifest["files"].items()):
                    safe_path(path.parent, name)
                    p = Path(entry["source_path"])
                    digest_file(p, entry["sha256"], entry["bytes"], entry["mode"])
                    info = tarfile.TarInfo(name)
                    info.size, info.mode = entry["bytes"], entry["mode"]
                    info.uid = info.gid = info.mtime = 0
                    info.uname = info.gname = ""
                    with p.open("rb") as source:
                        tar.addfile(info, source)
                    digest_file(p, entry["sha256"], entry["bytes"], entry["mode"])
    return {**digest_file(path), **full_xz(path)}

def verify_archive(path, manifest, expected):
    need(manifest["schema"] == MEMBER_SCHEMA, "dedicated-original-raw-member-schema")
    need(set(manifest) == {"schema", "native_output", "pure_output", "native_report_pins",
         "native_original_statuses", "pure_report_sha256", "files", "directories",
         "synthetic_container_directories", "file_count", "directory_count", "payload_bytes",
         "input_bindings", "execution_evidence", "source_profile_sha256", "mode_policy",
         "manifest_is_outside_archive", "native_Torch_compiler_or_recorded_admission_executed",
         "shared_carrier"}, "exact-whole-supplement-member-manifest-fields")
    need(manifest["manifest_is_outside_archive"] is True
         and manifest["native_Torch_compiler_or_recorded_admission_executed"] is False,
         "member-manifest-custody-only-scope")
    files, directories = manifest["files"], manifest["directories"]
    input_members = {}
    for index, (input_path, row) in enumerate(sorted(manifest["input_bindings"].items())):
        need(set(row) == {"path", "bytes", "sha256", "mode"} and row["path"] == input_path,
             "full-original-declared-input-record")
        name = "inputs/%04d-%s" % (index, Path(input_path).name)
        input_members[name] = {key: row[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "mode")}
        input_members[name]["source_path"] = input_path
    same({name: row for name, row in files.items() if name.startswith("inputs/")},
         input_members, "every-original-input-is-an-exact-archive-member")
    receipts = {}
    for index, row in enumerate(manifest["execution_evidence"]):
        name = "execution/%04d-%s" % (index, Path(row["path"]).name)
        receipts[name] = {key: row[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "mode")}
        receipts[name]["source_path"] = row["path"]
    same({name: row for name, row in files.items()
          if name.startswith("execution/") and name != "execution/seal-plan.json"},
         receipts, "every-original-execution-evidence-file-is-an-exact-member")
    need("execution/seal-plan.json" in files, "original-seal-plan-member")
    need(type(files) is dict and type(directories) is dict and set(files).isdisjoint(directories),
         "distinct-exact-file-directory-sets")
    need(manifest["file_count"] == len(files) and manifest["directory_count"] == len(directories)
         and manifest["payload_bytes"] == sum(entry["bytes"] for entry in files.values()),
         "whole-original-member-counts")
    for name, entry in files.items():
        safe_path(Path(path).parent, name)
        need(set(entry) == {"bytes", "sha256", "mode", "source_path"}
             and type(entry["bytes"]) is int and entry["bytes"] >= 0
             and type(entry["mode"]) is int and 0 <= entry["mode"] <= 0o7777,
             "exact-original-member-metadata")
    for name, mode in directories.items():
        safe_path(Path(path).parent, name)
        need(type(mode) is int and 0 <= mode <= 0o7777, "original-directory-mode")
    digest_file(path, expected["sha256"], expected["bytes"], expected["mode"])
    same(full_xz(path), {key: expected[key] for key in (
        "uncompressed_tar_bytes", "uncompressed_tar_sha256", "single_XZ_stream")},
        "complete-XZ-and-uncompressed-tar-digest")
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    with tarfile.open(path, "r:xz") as tar:
        for member in tar:
            name = member.name.rstrip("/") if member.isdir() else member.name
            need(not member.pax_headers and not member.issym() and not member.islnk()
                 and not member.issparse(), "no-unbound-archive-extension-link-or-sparse-member")
            if member.isdir():
                need(name in directories and name not in seen_dirs
                     and member.size == 0 and member.mode == directories[name],
                     "exact-original-directory-member", path=name)
                seen_dirs.add(name)
                continue
            need(member.isfile() and name in files and name not in seen_files,
                 "unique-declared-regular-tar-member", path=name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            entry = files[name]
            need(member.size == entry["bytes"] and member.mode == entry["mode"],
                 "complete-member-length-and-original-mode", path=name)
            source = tar.extractfile(member)
            need(source is not None, "whole-member-stream")
            h, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
            for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1 << 20), b""):
                h.update(block)
                count += len(block)
            need(count == entry["bytes"] and h.hexdigest() == entry["sha256"],
                 "whole-member-SHA256", path=name)
        # The LZMA trailer was already consumed above. TAR may stop at its first
        # zero header; all remaining uncompressed bytes must also be padding.
        tar.fileobj.seek(tar.offset)
        for block in iter(lambda: tar.fileobj.read(1 << 20), b""):
            need(not any(block), "no-hidden-members-or-data-after-first-tar-EOF")
    need(seen_files == set(files) and seen_dirs == set(directories), "exact-complete-tar-member-set")
    return {"file_count": len(files), "directory_count": len(directories),
            "payload_bytes": manifest["payload_bytes"],
            "archive_sha256": expected["sha256"],
            "all_file_bytes_modes_and_XZ_TAR_EOF_verified": True}

def verify_originals(manifest):
    for name, entry in manifest["files"].items():
        digest_file(entry["source_path"], entry["sha256"], entry["bytes"], entry["mode"])
    checked = {}
    for prefix, field in (("native-output", "native_output"), ("pure32-output", "pure_output")):
        root = Path(manifest[field])
        current_files, current_dirs = inventory(root)
        expected_files = {name[len(prefix)+1:]: entry for name, entry in manifest["files"].items()
                          if name.startswith(prefix+"/")}
        expected_dirs = {}
        for name, mode in manifest["directories"].items():
            if name == prefix:
                expected_dirs[""] = mode
            elif name.startswith(prefix+"/"):
                expected_dirs[name[len(prefix)+1:]] = mode
        same(current_files, expected_files, "all-original-tree-files-still-exact/"+prefix)
        same(current_dirs, expected_dirs, "all-original-tree-directories-still-exact/"+prefix)
        checked[prefix] = {"files": len(current_files), "directories": len(current_dirs)}
    return {"original_roots": checked, "all_archive_source_files_unchanged": True}

from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import tarfile
import traceback

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
COMMON = "a4ac713abf15756548d6b0be15c1d8287f73e6f4dee40a812415c1daf160f207"
raw = (HERE / "admission_common.py").read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != COMMON:
    raise AssertionError("fixed admission_common source")

EXTRA_AUDIT = {"resource_limit_attempts": 0}

def no_resource_change(event, args):

sys.addaudithook(no_resource_change)

def metadata(pin):
    return {key: pin[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "mode")}

def pinned(path, pin):
    return read(path, pin["sha256"], pin["bytes"], pin["mode"])

def framed_inverse(before, after, record):
    need(SHA(before) == record["before_sha256"] and SHA(after) == record["after_sha256"],
         "whole-source-inverse-original-and-successor-SHA")
    value = before
    for edit in record["edits"]:
        need(set(edit) == {"before", "after", "count"} and type(edit["count"]) is int
             and edit["count"] > 0, "exact-wholetext-edit-format")
        old, new = edit["before"].encode(), edit["after"].encode()
        need(value.count(old) == edit["count"], "whole-source-forward-occurrences")
        value = value.replace(old, new, edit["count"])
    need(value == after, "whole-source-forward-exact")
    for edit in reversed(record["edits"]):
        old, new = edit["after"].encode(), edit["before"].encode()
        need(value.count(old) == edit["count"], "whole-source-inverse-occurrences")
        value = value.replace(old, new, edit["count"])
    need(value == before, "whole-source-inverse-exact")

def package(pin):
    manifest = data(HERE / "source-manifest.json", pin)

    config_raw = read(HERE / "configuration.json")

    inverse = data(HERE / "recorded-profile-inverse.json")

                   read(HERE / inverse["after_path"]), inverse)

         and all(edit["count"] == 1 and "\n" not in edit["before"]

    cinverse = data(HERE / "archive-custody-inverse.json")

def take_members(archive, member_manifest, requested):

         "explicit-unique-shared-members")

                 and member.size == row["bytes"] and member.mode == row["mode"],

            stream = tar.extractfile(member)

def suite_evidence(runs, config):

def unwrap_tool(response):

        return response["structuredContent"]
    text = [row["text"] for row in response["content"] if row["type"] == "text"]
    need(len(text) == 1, "one-original-tool-JSON-result")
    return json.loads(text[0])

            "--source": str(Path(config["original_runs_root"]) / "sum-dims-f32-native-build-source04-01/candidate-sum-dims/runtime.hepta"),
            "--build-report": str(Path(config["original_runs_root"]) / "sum-dims-f32-native-build-source04-01/candidate-sum-dims/build.json"),
            "--protocol": config["modules"]["protocol"]["original_path"],
            "--observer": config["modules"]["observer"]["original_path"],
            "--reference": spec["reference"]["original_path"],
            "--probe": spec["probe"]["original_path"],
            "--expected-source-sha256": config["profile"]["source_sha256"],
            "--expected-native-sha256": config["profile"]["native_sha256"],
            "--expected-observer-sha256": config["modules"]["observer"]["sha256"],
            "--expected-functions": "696", "--expected-native-units": "14",
            "--output": str(suite["base"]),
        }
        if spec["family"] != "14":
            wanted_options["--support-reader"] = config["modules"]["support"]["original_path"]
        if spec["family"] in {"26", "4"}:
            wanted_options["--expected-reference-sha256"] = spec["reference"]["sha256"]
        if spec["family"] == "26":
            wanted_options["--identity-adapter"] = config["modules"]["identity_epochs"]["original_path"]
            wanted_options["--parent-reader"] = config["modules"]["parent26"]["original_path"]

        need(script in suite["custody"]
             and suite["custody"][script]["sha256"] == spec["reader_sha256"],
             "executed-reader-is-original-frozen-reader")
        same(row["original_report"], {"path": str(suite["base"] / "report.json"), **spec["report"]},
             "operator-receipt-binds-whole-native-report")
        results.append({"name": row["name"], "job_id": row["job_id"], "exit_code": 0,
                        "full_stdout_bytes": logs["stdout"]["size"], "full_stderr_bytes": 0,
                        "both_EOF": True, "original_request_exact": True})
    return {"path": str(path), **metadata(pin)}, results

def new_manifest(runs, output, config, package_manifest, config_pin, custody,
                 native_totals, pure_evidence, receipt, shared):
    roots = (("native-output", safe_path(runs, config["native_root"])),
             ("pure32-output", safe_path(runs, config["pure_root"])))
    files, directories = {}, {"inputs": 0o700, "execution": 0o700}
    for prefix, root in roots:
        observed_files, observed_dirs = custody.inventory(root)
        for rel, row in observed_files.items():
            files[prefix + "/" + rel] = row
        for rel, mode in observed_dirs.items():
            directories[prefix + ("/" + rel if rel else "")] = mode
    inputs = {}
    for rel, pin in package_manifest["files"].items():
        path = safe_path(HERE, rel)
        inputs[str(path)] = {"path": str(path), **digest_file(path, pin["sha256"], pin["bytes"], pin["mode"])}
    self_manifest = HERE / "source-manifest.json"
    inputs[str(self_manifest)] = {"path": str(self_manifest), **digest_file(self_manifest)}
    for row in config["additional_input_sources"]:
        path = Path(row["path"])
        need(str(path) not in inputs, "unique-additional-original-source")
        inputs[str(path)] = {"path": str(path), **digest_file(path, row["sha256"], row["bytes"], row["mode"])}
    for index, (path, row) in enumerate(sorted(inputs.items())):
        name = "inputs/%04d-%s" % (index, Path(path).name)
        files[name] = {"source_path": path, **metadata(row)}
    receipts = [receipt]
    for index, row in enumerate(receipts):
        name = "execution/%04d-%s" % (index, Path(row["path"]).name)
        files[name] = {"source_path": row["path"], **metadata(row)}
    plan = {"schema": "heptatorch.sum03.original76.actual-seal-plan.v1",
            "source_package_sha256": SHA(read(self_manifest)), "configuration_sha256": config_pin,

            "pure_root": str(roots[1][1]), "shared_carrier": shared,

            "complete_roots_no_file_filters": True, "new_native_Torch_compiler_executions": 0,
            "new_recorded_comparisons": 0, "original_statuses_not_rewritten": True}
    plan_path = output / "seal-plan.json"
    plan_meta = write(plan_path, plan)
    files["execution/seal-plan.json"] = {"source_path": str(plan_path), **plan_meta}
    return {
        "schema": custody.MEMBER_SCHEMA, "native_output": str(roots[0][1]),
        "pure_output": str(roots[1][1]),
        "native_report_pins": {s["name"]: {"path": str(safe_path(runs, s["root"]) / "report.json"),
                                         **s["report"]} for s in config["suites"]},

        "file_count": len(files), "directory_count": len(directories),
        "payload_bytes": sum(row["bytes"] for row in files.values()),

        "source_profile_sha256": config_pin,

        "manifest_is_outside_archive": True,

        "shared_carrier": shared,

    same(manifest["shared_carrier"], shared, "manifest-exact-shared-carrier")

    same(binding["pure32_original"], pure_evidence, "whole-existing-recorded32-result")

         "all-four-original-statuses-preserved")

    originals = custody.verify_originals(manifest)
    sealrow = binding["sealing_report"]
    report = json.loads(pinned(sealrow["path"], sealrow))
    need(report["status"] == "PASS_CUSTODY_ONLY"

                "original76_totals", "pure32_original"):
        same(report[key], binding[key], "sealer-whole-binding/" + key)
    same(report["file_manifest"], binding["member_manifest"], "sealer-manifest-byte-binding")
    return binding, manifest, {"archive": checked, "originals": originals}

"""Recorded-only admission of all four original696 suites.

Every Case predicate and native event mapper is loaded from the exact executed
source copy. The frozen RecordedSession, Owners and RecordedCase implementation
has only five profile constants changed; its complete function bodies are intact.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import json
import os
import traceback
from admission_common import SHA, BOUND, AUDIT, need, read, data, write, safe_path, same, digest_file, load

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STAGE_NAMES = {
    "support": "support.py", "protocol": "protocol.py", "client": "owner_client.py",
    "observer": "native_observer.py", "shape26": "shape26.py", "scalar32": "scalar32.py",
    "direct14": "direct14.py", "input4": "input4.py",
    "identity_epochs": "identity_epochs.py", "parent26": "parent26.py",
}

def stage_bytes(path, raw, expected_sha256, mode):
    need(SHA(raw) == expected_sha256 and not path.exists(), "exact-create-only-module-copy")
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
        stream.flush()
        os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), mode)
    read(path, expected_sha256, len(raw), mode)
    return path

def modules(config, suites, selected, output):
    directory = output / "frozen-modules"
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
    need(set(config["modules"]) == set(STAGE_NAMES), "all-and-only-explicit-frozen-modules")
    staged, receipt = {}, {}
    for name, pin in config["modules"].items():
        original = suites[pin["suite"]]
        actual_copy = original["custody"][pin["original_path"]]
        same(actual_copy, {"copy": pin["copy"], "bytes": pin["bytes"], "sha256": pin["sha256"]},
             "exact-original-native-input-module")
        source = safe_path(original["base"], pin["copy"])
        raw = read(source, pin["sha256"], pin["bytes"])
        mode = BOUND[str(source)]["mode"]
        target = stage_bytes(directory / STAGE_NAMES[name], raw, pin["sha256"], mode)
        staged[name] = target
        receipt[name] = {"original_source_path": pin["original_path"], "recorded_copy": str(source),
                         "staged_path": str(target), "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": pin["sha256"],
                         "original_recorded_copy_mode": mode, "staged_mode": mode}
    # The unchanged protocol imports owner_client.py by adjacent filename.
    # Both bytes were checked before any protocol import.
    loaded = {}
    for name in STAGE_NAMES:
        if name != "client":
            loaded[name] = load(staged[name], "sum696_frozen_" + name, config["modules"][name]["sha256"])
    owner_pin = config["owner"]
    owner_raw = selected[owner_pin["archive_member"]]
    need(len(owner_raw) == owner_pin["bytes"] and SHA(owner_raw) == owner_pin["sha256"],
         "owner-is-exact-original-shared-member")
    owner_path = stage_bytes(directory / "owner_sum47_48.py", owner_raw,
                             owner_pin["sha256"], owner_pin["original_mode"])
    owner = load(owner_path, "sum696_strict84Q_owner", owner_pin["sha256"])
    need(owner.SOURCE is None and owner.IMAGE is None and owner.DESCRIPTOR == 672,
         "strict-owner-original-explicit-profile-API")
    # These are the public profile binding parameters of the unchanged native32
    # owner. No owner predicates or role equations are rewritten.
    owner.SOURCE = config["profile"]["source_sha256"]
    owner.IMAGE = config["profile"]["native_sha256"]
    owner.PROFILE = "sum03-original696-recorded76"
    loaded["owner"] = owner
    receipt["owner"] = {"archive_member": owner_pin["archive_member"],
                        "sha256": owner_pin["sha256"], "bytes": len(owner_raw),
                        "staged_path": str(owner_path), "staged_mode": owner_pin["original_mode"],
                        "runtime_profile_binding_only": {"SOURCE": owner.SOURCE, "IMAGE": owner.IMAGE,
                                                         "PROFILE": owner.PROFILE},
                        "owner_function_bodies_modified": False}

    return loaded, receipt

def reference(family, suite, loaded, support):
    refpin, probepin = suite["spec"]["reference"], suite["spec"]["probe"]
    raw = read(suite["reference"], refpin["sha256"], refpin["bytes"])
    probe = read(suite["probe"], probepin["sha256"], probepin["bytes"])
    if family == "26":
        loaded["shape26"].admit_reference(raw, probe, refpin["sha256"], support)
        original, plan = loaded["identity_epochs"].admit(raw, probe)
        plan["copied_negative_controls"] = loaded["identity_epochs"].negative_controls(json.loads(raw), plan)
        proof = read(suite["base"] / "identity-epoch-plan.json",
                     suite["aggregate"]["identity_epoch_admission"]["proof_sha256"])
        need((json.dumps(plan, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode() == proof,
             "whole-original-identity-epoch-proof-recomputed")

             and plan["identity_annotations"] == 208 and len(plan["copied_negative_controls"]) == 6,
             "fixed-proven-released-object-lifetime-epoch-boundaries")

             "exact-original-reference-recoverable-by-epoch-inverse")

        original = {**original, "states": original["full_rng_states"]}
        Case = loaded["scalar32"].case_class(support)

         and bridge.BUILD == config["profile"]["build_sha256"]

                original = data(original_directory / "report.json")
                for key, value in summary.items():
                    same(original[key], value, "whole-original-case-summary/" + key)
                need(original["index"] == row["index"] and original["name"] == row["name"]
                     and original["status"] == "PASS" and original["error"] is None
                     and original["mismatches"] == [] and original["exit_code"] == 0,
                     "actual-original-native-case-success")
                need(original["reference_event_count"] == len(original["operations"]) == len(row["events"]),
                     "every-original-reference-event-exported")
                result = Case(args, observer, observed, row, destination, original_directory,
                              original, owner, family).run_admission()
            except BaseException as error:
                destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                result = {"schema": "heptatorch.sum03.original76.recorded-case-failure.v1",
                          "status": "FAIL", "suite": family, "index": row["index"], "name": row["name"],
                          "error": repr(error), "traceback": traceback.format_exc(),
                          "original_report_path": str(original_directory / "report.json"),
                          "new_native_executions": 0, "new_Torch_executions": 0,
                          "original_reports_modified": False}
                path = destination / ("attempt-failure.json" if (destination / "report.json").exists()
                                      else "report.json")
                write(path, result)
            results.append(result)
            these.append(result)
        suite_result = {"suite": family, "name": spec["name"], "cases": spec["cases"],
                        "passed_cases": sum(r["status"] == "PASS_PURE_RECORDED_EVIDENCE" for r in these),
                        "failed_cases": sum(r["status"] != "PASS_PURE_RECORDED_EVIDENCE" for r in these),
                        "original_report_sha256": spec["report"]["sha256"],
                        "original_input_copy_count": len(suite["custody"])}
        write(suite_output / "summary.json", suite_result)
        suite_results.append(suite_result)
    write(output / "recorded-case-results.json", {"cases": results, "suites": suite_results})
    need(len(results) == 76 and all(row["status"] == "PASS_PURE_RECORDED_EVIDENCE" for row in results),
         "all76-recorded-cases-no-status-transfer",
         failed=[{"suite": r["suite"], "index": r["index"], "error": r.get("error")}
                 for r in results if r["status"] != "PASS_PURE_RECORDED_EVIDENCE"])
    total_keys = (
        "pure_comparisons", "exact_words_recomputed", "full_rng_bytes_recomputed",
        "all_raw_frames_generated_and_matched", "exported_snapshots_compared",
        "physical_Tensor_reads_from_full_owner", "full_owner_blobs_invariant_checked",
        "full_owner_records", "directly_exported_adjacent_rollback_pairs",
        "directly_exported_adjacent_rollback_bytes", "original_refusal_bytes_source_bound",
        "refusals_without_exported_immediate_before_owner",
    )
    totals = {key: sum(row[key] for row in results) for key in total_keys}
    wanted = config["expected_totals"]
    for key, expected in (("exact_words_recomputed", wanted["exact_words"]),
                          ("full_rng_bytes_recomputed", wanted["full_rng_bytes"]),
                          ("all_raw_frames_generated_and_matched", wanted["frames"]),
                          ("original_refusal_bytes_source_bound", wanted["source_bound_refusal_bytes"])):
        same(totals[key], expected, "all-original-expected-counts/" + key)
    same(sum(row["original_assertions"] for row in results), wanted["original_assertions"],
         "original-assertion-count-preserved-not-all-claimed-recomputed")
    bridge.recheck_bound()
    for path, expected in bridge.BOUND.items():
        digest_file(path, expected["sha256"], expected["bytes"], expected["mode"])
    need(not any(bridge.AUDIT.values()) and not any(AUDIT.values()),
         "no-process-or-live-memory-in-recorded-replay")
    return {
        "status": "PASS_PURE_RECORDED_76", "source_sha256": config["profile"]["source_sha256"],
        "native_sha256": config["profile"]["native_sha256"],
        "original_semantic_reader_sha256": config["recorded_bridge"]["original_sha256"],
        "profile_bound_semantic_reader_sha256": config["recorded_bridge"]["sha256"],
        "original_native_qualification_transferred": False,

# Sum03 original696: complete original76 and recorded32 supplement

This source package is an unexecuted, independently reviewable addition. It does
not alter any original source, reference, report, raw frame or historical failure.
The publication audit remains at scope-sum03-publication-audit-01. Whole PyTorch
qualification remains HOLD, with zero of 2590 schemas closed.

## Exact original evidence

The four actual native suites are view26, scalar32, view14 and input4, all on the
same 696-function, 14-unit image. They contain 76 cases, 82,503 original frames,
66,165 compared raw words, 11,295,104 complete RNG bytes and 481,580 original
assertions. Their original refusal accounting is 2,143,906,608 bytes. This last
number is not automatically a claim that every before-refusal owner was exported.

The existing native32 carrier is 49e72ac6... complete.tar.xz. Its complete member
manifest, binding and explicit role map are required. The new program verifies
the entire archive, all member bytes and modes, one XZ stream and complete TAR
EOF. The 315 original inputs and 22 additional source/execution members remain
in that carrier. The actual build's 177 input records, fourteen source/object
pairs and fifteen original compile/link transports are bound to those members.
The existing carrier is neither copied nor recompressed.

The supplement contains the complete original76 directory, the complete existing
recorded32 output directory, the frozen source of this supplement, the 23
publication-source files outside the existing carrier, and the actual operator
receipt c34ca47c.... The original recorded32 report 65a054e3... and its complete
35,511,212-byte reconstruction of ba890543... are preserved exactly. The
recorded32 program is not rerun by this supplement.

The operator receipt preserves exact first-start requests, the original starts,
authoritative successful terminals and whole original stdout/stderr EOF for
the four 696 suites and the recorded32 run. It was recovered read-only by root.
A saved report alone is not accepted as proof of process completion.

## Source boundary

* admission_common.py and archive_custody_original.py are exact frozen parents.
* recorded_sum03.py differs from original 20b23badd... in five top-level profile
  constants only. RecordedSession, Owners, recorded_case_class, every comparison
  function and every function body are unchanged. The complete original source
  and a literal bidirectional inverse are included. Its old main and prepare
  functions are retained for provenance and never called.
* archive_custody_sum76.py has a complete literal inverse. It changes only the
  outer manifest contract, the two-root original-files check and the unused
  binding entry. Original member-byte, mode and XZ/TAR EOF checks are retained.

  696 native runs. The four Cases inherit their original comparison methods.
  No expected tensor, gradient, rounding result, Version or error is computed.
* The strict 84-word owner is the actual owner_sum47_48.py, hash 0eadfed8...,
  from the existing carrier. Its original SOURCE/IMAGE binding API is used;
  no owner function or role predicate is edited. General ViewInfo transitions
  are not claimed to have been rechecked.

## Two separate operations

The root executor supplies the complete source-manifest SHA explicitly.

    /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B supplement.py \
      --package-sha256 ACTUAL_SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA \
      --runs-root /home/qian-qi/heptatorch-continuation-20261116/runs \
      --output NEW_SEAL_DIRECTORY \

This operation seals custody only. It writes a complete.tar.xz, file-manifest,
seal-plan, report and evidence-binding in a fresh directory. It never constructs
a native Session or executes a Tensor program, compiler or Torch. Failure leaves
the complete attempted output intact and produces a FAIL report. A later binding
write failure is saved separately without overwriting a completed custody report.

After root independently observes the completed seal and its exact binding SHA:

raw physical Tensor/gradient bytes. Family32 keeps its original Saved-getter order.

Current admission intentionally requires the original ROG runs root. It does not
silently rewrite absolute input paths. A later repository adapter must explicitly
map carrier members, source paths, original modes and Git installation modes,

Original files and directories are archived with their original modes. Only the

Both entry modes are guarded against processes, Torch/native library loading,
